review_candidates.description: À propos de Workleap Workleap est une entreprise tech montréalaise fondée en 2006. Bâtisseurs dans l'âme, on crée des produits simples qui font une réelle différence pour ceux qui les utilisent. On a deux lignes de produits : L'agent Workleap, notre nouvelle solution conçue pour aider chaque gestionnaire à être plus efficace et ShareGate, la référence mondiale de migration et de gouvernance Microsoft 365. Plus de 15 000 entreprises dans le monde nous font confiance pour faire exactement ça. On est intentionnels dans notre choix des gens qu'on recrute : des personnes qui ont envie de retrousser leurs manches et de construire quelque chose de significatif dans une des périodes les plus excitantes de l'histoire de la tech. Ton rôle En tant qu'administrateur.trice système, tu vas assurer le bon fonctionnement des fondations de Workleap : notre infrastructure hébergée sur Azure, les identités et les accès qui connectent tout le monde à leurs outils, et les services de sécurité qui les protègent. Notre infrastructure vit maintenant dans le cloud, et on a besoin de quelqu'un qui peut l'opérer avec rigueur et l'améliorer continuellement par le code plutôt que par des interventions manuelles. Tu travailleras en étroite collaboration avec les équipes de soutien TI et de sécurité, et tu seras la personne vers qui on se tourne quand un incident se complique. Ton impact : Prendre en charge notre infrastructure Azure (machines virtuelles, sauvegardes, VPN et politiques) pour garder les systèmes de Workleap fiables, sécurisés et disponibles à mesure que l'entreprise grandit. Piloter Entra ID, Active Directory, Conditional Access et Zscaler pour que chaque employé.e ait le bon accès aux bons outils, sans friction. Prendre en charge le cycle de vie des certificats et les correctifs (DigiCert, DCV, Azure Key Vault) pour prévenir les pannes et les failles de sécurité avant qu'elles touchent nos équipes. Construire et livrer l'infrastructure as code avec Terraform et un flux de travail par pull request Git, pour que chaque changement soit reproductible, révisé et traçable. Intégrer des outils d'IA comme Claude aux flux de travail TI pour automatiser les tâches récurrentes et accélérer la résolution des incidents. Mener des projets d'infrastructure dans Jira et Confluence pour aider l'équipe TI à absorber les nouveaux outils et les acquisitions en douceur. Ton équipe Au cours des 6 à 12 prochains mois, l'équipe va aider à intégrer les nouveaux employés et les nouvelles technologies, à améliorer et automatiser les processus TI existants, et à déployer de nouveaux outils et processus. On est une équipe de six expert.es qui travaillent dans des disciplines comme le soutien TI et l'administration des postes de travail, et on fait rouler Workleap et ses produits chaque jour. La plupart de cela te ressemble ? Postule. Ce que le poste inclut Salaire de base : 80 000$ à 105 000$. Cette fourchette reflète notre échelle salariale pancanadienne. L'offre finale peut être ajustée selon la région du candidat pour s'aligner avec les conditions du marché local. Programme de bonus annuel. Programme LTIP, participation à la croissance à long terme de Workleap. REER + Assurances collectives familiales + télémédecine + budget bien-être annuel. Politique de vacances flexible. Télétravail, avec accès à nos bureaux de Montréal. Rassemblement en personne deux fois par an. Claude accessible à tous. Ce qui nous anime Chez Workleap, on construit des logiciels au cœur de l'expérience de travail, au quotidien, à tous les niveaux. On avance vite. Les priorités évoluent, les décisions se prennent avec l'information qu'on a, et on itère. Si tu carbures à l'intensité et que l'ambiguïté ne te fait pas peur, tu vas te sentir chez toi. On est des bâtisseurs. On fait ce qu'il faut pour avancer. L'IA fait partie de l'arsenal. On l'utilise pour aller plus vite et décider plus intelligemment, pas pour remplacer le jugement. Si tu veux de l'impact réel et un endroit où tes décisions comptent, c'est ici. Comment on recrute La transparence, c'est notre façon de recruter — pour toi comme pour nous. Voici comment ça se passe : un premier échange avec un.e recruteur.euse, puis un entretien virtuel avec le.la gestionnaire d'embauche. Tu complètes ensuite une étude de cas à faire chez toi, suivie d'une rencontre avec de futur.es collègues pour en discuter ensemble. Selon le poste, le parcours peut varier légèrement — ton.ta recruteur.euse t'en donnera tous les détails lors de votre premier appel. On utilise l'IA pour soutenir certaines étapes du processus, mais chaque décision d'embauche reste humaine. On a hâte de te rencontrer. En postulant, tu confirmes avoir lu et accepté notre politique de confidentialité.

(이력서 자율양식) ✅ AD 운영 및 아키텍처 설계 🚀 합류하실 팀을 소개해요 계정인증개발팀은 그룹사의 계정 관리와 SSO 인증, 부가인증 등 보안 서비스를 다루는 중요한 업무를 담당하고 있어요. 2024년 신설된 팀으로 기존 담당하던 서비스에 더하여 신규 프로젝트도 활발히 진행하는 중이에요. 신규 프로젝트를 통해 대외적으로는 기존보다 안정적이고 개선된 서비스를 제공하고 내적으로는 많은 개발 기회와 다양한 업무를 경험할 수 있는 성장 가능성이 높은 팀이에요. 💻 합류하시면 함께 할 업무예요 인프라 설계 및 운영 : 자동차 그룹(완성차, 그룹사) AD 포리스트/도메인 아키텍처 설계, 도메인 컨트롤러(DC 설치), 업그레이드 및 패치 관리 보안 및 컴플라이언스 : 그룹 정책(GPO)을 통한 보안 강화(생성/수정/오류 조치), AD 권한 관리, 취약점 진단 및 보안 사고 대응 IAM 및 인증 관리 : LDAP, Kerberos, SAML, OAuth 기반 인증 지원 및 Azure AD(Entra ID)와의 하이브리드 동기화 관리 프로젝트 구축 PM : AD 구축 및 연계시스템(CA, DNS, DHCP, MECM/WSUS, WEC) 아키텍처 설계 경험 🔍 이런 분과 함께 하고 싶어요 Active Directory 운영 경험 5년 이상 MECM/WSUS 패치/배포/운영 경험 CA 서버 관리 경험 DNS/DHCP서버 구성/운영 경험 운영 문서 작성 및 기술 커뮤니케이션 역량 #Active Directory #M365 #계정인증 🔍 이런 분이라면 더욱 좋아요 Microsoft Azure(Entra ID), M365 도입 및 하이브리드 구성 경험 AD 보안 강화 도구(BloodHound, PingCastle 등) 사용 경험 및 관련 자격증(MCSE, CISSP 등) 보유 대규모 서버PC의 AD Join 및 사용자 권한 구성 경험 영어, 중국어 등 외국어 능력 우대 해외 출장 가능자 우대 ⌛ 이렇게 합류해요 서류 접수 → 서류 검토 → 직무역량테스트(과제) 및 인성검사 → 1차면접 → 2차면접 → 처우협의 및 채용검진 → 최종 합격🎉 ※ 상기 직무역량테스트 外 추가 역량평가가 진행될 수 있으며, 해당 결과는 종합적인 역량 검토를 위한 참고자료로 활용됩니다. 📍 만나게 될 근무지는 여기예요 서울 강남 📣 동료의 한 마디 계정인증개발팀은 배울 점이 많은 시니어와 에너지 가득한 주니어가 적절히 섞인 팀이에요 (ºㅁº)/ 팀원 모두 늘 열린 마음으로 서로의 의견을 듣고, 유쾌한 농담을 주고받으며 화기애애한 분위기를 만들어가요. 수직적인 구조 속에서 신속한 의사 결정이 이루어지고, 각자의 역할과 책임이 명확하게 구분되어 있어 업무 효율성을 극대화할 수 있어요. 하지만 팀원간의 소통은 수평적으로 활발히 진행되기 때문에 친밀하고 유기적인 상호관계를 바탕으로 시너지가 발생한답니다. 같이 일하고 싶으신 분들 많이 많이 지원해 주세요~! XD (팀 리더) 계정인증개발팀은 서버, 모바일, AD 등 다양한 포지션의 개발자들로 구성된 팀이에요. 다양한 분야만큼이나 다양한 개발 스택 및 운영 환경을 다루고 있어요. 계정과 인증에 대한 서비스를 다루기 때문에 개성있는 업무를 경험할 수 있고 새로운 보안적 요소를 적용해보는 등 관련 분야의 전문가로 성장 할 수 있는 기회가 많아요. 📌 참고해 주세요 채용 시 마감되는 상시 채용 공고로 운영되며, 채용 절차와 일정은 변동될 수 있어요. 사회적 배려 대상자(보훈 취업지원대상자, 장애인)는 관계 법령과 내규에 따라 우대해요. 모집 분야 및 담당 업무에 따라 영어 구술평가, 레퍼런스 체크, 또는 기타 전형이 실시될 수 있어요. 지원자의 경험과 역량을 고려하여 다른 포지션이 더 적합하다고 판단되는 경우 지원 분야가 변경될 수 있어요. 배치 부서 및 근무지는 회사 사정에 따라 변경될 수 있어요. 아래의 경우, 합격이 취소되거나 전형 진행에서 불이익을 받으실 수 있어요. 지원서가 사실과 다르거나 증빙이 불가할 경우 해외여행 결격 사유가 있는 경우 (남성의 경우, 회사가 지정한 입사일까지 병역 필 또는 면제 필요) 최종 합격 후 회사가 지정하는 입사일에 입사 불가한 경우

review_candidates.title: InfraOps Support Manager, Operations Management Center (OMC)
review_candidates.description: Description The InfraOps Support Manager leads a two-tiered team of engineers within Amazon's Operations Management Center (OMC) -a 24/7/365 team that keeps the technology inside Amazon's 400+ corporate office buildings running across Networking, Audio-Visual (AV), and Print services. As one of OMC's regional managers, this role owns a segment of the team's follow-the-sun coverage (the model in which AMER, EMEA, and APAC teams hand work across time zones for continuous 24/7 coverage). The manager balances hands-on technical leadership with people management: they run day-to-day operations to meet service levels, develop and coach engineers, build and maintain operational mechanisms, drive operational inspection and continuous improvement, and partner closely with Service Managers/Owners and IT Services partner teams. They work with minimum supervision to deliver operational changes and projects focused on infrastructure services, and thrive in an ambiguous, collaborative environment while building high-performing teams. Key job responsibilities On a Typical Week, An InfraOps Support Manager Will Operational Leadership & Service Delivery Keep the 24/7 operation healthy and meeting its commitments. Lead the team to deliver results, ensure the operation runs properly, meets SLAs, and drives the right customer outcomes across Networking, AV, and Print. Audit work queues and SLA adherence; audit engineers' work to ensure results are high-quality. Own a portion of follow-the-sun coverage: build and maintain gap-free shift schedules and a sustainable on-call rotation that supports 24/7 operations without burning out engineers. Manage difficult problems and escalations, identify and mitigate immediate risks before they become roadblocks, and decide when to handle directly versus escalate. Make operational trade-offs across time, quality, and resources. Operational Inspection & Continuous Improvement Inspect the operation and make it measurably better. Perform operational inspection: establish and run mechanisms (e.g., weekly operations reviews) that inspect performance metrics and drive corrective action. Prioritize root-cause resolution and process improvements; partner with teams to improve mechanisms and drive enhancements. Dive deep into incident causes, and establish, iterate, and deploy best practices across OMC and its partner teams. Identify and optimize workflows and best practices for operational excellence. People Management & Talent Development Build and grow a high-performing team. Hire, attract, and onboard bar-raising talent; own customized onboarding plans that ramp new engineers quickly. Set clear performance expectations and provide regular feedback; hold regular 1:1s and team meetings. Evaluate engineers against the appropriate role guidelines, participate in calibration, and clearly document performance and progression. Coach and develop engineers toward their career goals; lead the promotion process for those consistently performing at the next level. Address underperformance by clearly documenting the required change, communicating it respectfully with a timeframe, and seeking guidance from HR and leadership as needed. Navigate challenging conversations with empathy, escalating or seeking HR/leadership guidance when appropriate. Create and continuously improve a team environment where every engineer feels valued, trusted, connected, and informed, and support work-life harmony across time zones. Stakeholder Partnership & Communication Represent the team up, down, and across. Work closely with Service Managers/Owners and IT Services partner teams to resolve escalations and align priorities. Communicate the team's mission, vision, and priorities, helping engineers see how their work contributes to organization goals. Be clear and concise in verbal and written communication (narratives, WBR/MBR/QBR); put the right people in the room; trusted to present decisions to leaders up to three levels above. Write clear documentation and may be accountable for Correction of Error (COE) write-ups. Technical Leadership Stay close enough to the technology to lead it well. Maintain a solid understanding of the design approaches and technologies used by the team (Networking, AV, Print) to guide technical decisions and trade-offs. Lead the team through building, implementing, and managing solutions to difficult operational problems. review_candidates.title: Lead Infrastructure Engineer — Global Office IT Physical Infra
review_candidates.description: About Nu Nu serves more than 140 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services. Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability. Visit our Institutional Page About The Role Every Nubank office runs on an IT Room that most people never see. Power distribution, cooling, structured cabling and fiber are the layer that keeps thousands of Nubankers connected and working — and when that layer fails, entire sites stop. Nubank's office portfolio is growing across countries, and today each site has been built to its own standard. The ETS team owns the physical layer of these environments — structured cabling, optical fiber and, in partnership with other teams, power distribution, HVAC, fire protection and physical security systems. This role exists to bring one engineering standard to all of them. As Lead Infrastructure Engineer for Global Office IT Physical Infra, you are the technical reference for IT Room infrastructure across Nubank's global office portfolio. You assess and size environments, define the technical specifications new sites and expansions must meet, and coordinate the vendors and construction teams who build them — so that an IT Room in Mexico City, São Paulo or Miami is built, documented and operated the same way. This is a senior individual contributor role with technical authority rather than direct reports. You set the standard, you review the projects against it, and you catch the gaps before they become outages. You'll be responsible for Assessing and sizing IT Rooms for expansion and improvement projects, defining the technical and physical specifications that meet real capacity needs, optimize resource use, and hold to operational standards. Executing deployment projects for new environments and expansions in compliance with established technical specifications, and coordinating deployment logistics end to end while ensuring quality standards throughout. Acting as the interface between internal teams and external vendors — translating business needs into infrastructure requirements, work orders and technical specifications — and managing those vendors and service providers to quality, deadline and compliance with Nubank's standards. Coordinating with construction and engineering teams during the build-out of new offices, ensuring IT Room specifications are met from the earliest project phases rather than retrofitted later. Creating and maintaining clear, current technical documentation — standards, procedures, capacity plans, topology diagrams, bayfaces — so that every site is aligned and auditable. Ensuring alignment between physical infrastructure and IT operations, including cabling changes, equipment installation, capacity planning and structured cabling terminations. Driving continuous improvement in the availability, resilience and efficiency of IT Room physical infrastructure: HVAC, structured cabling, optical fiber, power distribution, generators, UPS units and fire protection. Supporting the assessment of the global IT Room portfolio across corporate offices, identifying gaps and standardization opportunities across multiple sites and countries. We are looking for a person who has Solid experience with mission-critical environment infrastructure, including the deployment and operation of physical infrastructure in corporate offices or data center facilities. Strong hands-on command of mission-critical infrastructure systems: HVAC and air conditioning, structured cabling, optical fiber, low-voltage power distribution, UPS units, generators, and fire detection and suppression. Proven experience coordinating deployment projects that run structured cabling, electrical, mechanical and civil scopes simultaneously. Experience managing vendors and service providers on infrastructure projects — from technical specification through execution and acceptance. A consistent track record of creating and maintaining clear technical documentation for infrastructure standards, procedures and projects. A completed degree in Electrical, Electronic or Mechanical Engineering Advanced English enough to work with international vendors, standards and distributed teams. Proficiency in AutoCAD. Availability to work in a hybrid model and to travel to Nubank office locations for site assessments and deployments. Location for this opportunity (City, Country) Mexico City, Mexico Our Benefits Chance of earning equity at Nu Extended maternity and paternity leaves Health and life insurance Dental and Vision Insurance NuCare — Our mental health and wellness assistance program Nucleo — Our learning platform of courses NuLanguage — Our language learning program Holiday Bonus ("Aguinaldo") of 30 days of pay per year 17 days of paid vacation with 25% vacation bonus Gym partnership Food card Work-from-home Allowance Parental Consultancy Relocation Assistance Package, if applicable Work Model for this Role Hybrid 2-3 times/week: Our hybrid work model brings us to the office at least twice a week, on strategic days designed to maximize team connection and collaboration.
